The chart compares reported human baseline scores with each benchmark’s latest
reported AI score. Use the dropdowns to focus on a modality or reasoning type,
and hover over points for details. Scores are not perfectly comparable across
benchmarks because their tasks and human evaluation methods differ; missing
scores are left out.

Source: [AI Benchmarks vs Human Baselines on Kaggle](https://www.kaggle.com/datasets/kylefengkfeng209/ai-benchmarks-vs-human-baselines).

```{python}
#| echo: false

from pathlib import Path

import altair as alt
import pandas as pd

data_file = next(
    (
        folder / "data" / "benchmarks.csv"
        for folder in [Path.cwd(), *Path.cwd().parents]
        if (folder / "data" / "benchmarks.csv").exists()
    ),
    None,
)

if data_file is None:
    raise FileNotFoundError("Could not find data/benchmarks.csv")

benchmarks = pd.read_csv(data_file)

score_columns = ["human_baseline_pct", "best_ai_latest_pct"]
for column in score_columns:
    benchmarks[column] = pd.to_numeric(benchmarks[column], errors="coerce")

benchmarks["modality"] = benchmarks["modality"].fillna("Unknown")
benchmarks["reasoning_type"] = benchmarks["reasoning_type"].fillna("Unknown")

plot_data = (
    benchmarks[
        ["benchmark", "modality", "reasoning_type", *score_columns]
    ]
    .melt(
        id_vars=["benchmark", "modality", "reasoning_type"],
        value_vars=score_columns,
        var_name="measure",
        value_name="score",
    )
    .dropna(subset=["score"])
)

plot_data["measure"] = plot_data["measure"].map(
    {
        "human_baseline_pct": "Human baseline",
        "best_ai_latest_pct": "Latest AI",
    }
)

benchmark_order = (
    benchmarks.sort_values("best_ai_latest_pct", ascending=False)["benchmark"]
    .drop_duplicates()
    .tolist()
)

modalities = sorted(plot_data["modality"].unique())
reasoning_types = sorted(plot_data["reasoning_type"].unique())

modality_filter = alt.param(
    name="modality_filter",
    value="All",
    bind=alt.binding_select(
        options=["All", *modalities],
        name="Modality: ",
    ),
)

reasoning_filter = alt.param(
    name="reasoning_filter",
    value="All",
    bind=alt.binding_select(
        options=["All", *reasoning_types],
        name="Reasoning type: ",
    ),
)

chart = (
    alt.Chart(plot_data)
    .mark_circle(size=110, opacity=0.85)
    .encode(
        x=alt.X(
            "score:Q",
            title="Score (%)",
            scale=alt.Scale(domain=[0, 100]),
        ),
        y=alt.Y(
            "benchmark:N",
            title=None,
            sort=benchmark_order,
            axis=alt.Axis(labelLimit=200),
        ),
        color=alt.Color(
            "measure:N",
            title="Score",
            scale=alt.Scale(
                domain=["Human baseline", "Latest AI"],
                range=["#4C78A8", "#F58518"],
            ),
        ),
        tooltip=[
            alt.Tooltip("benchmark:N", title="Benchmark"),
            alt.Tooltip("measure:N", title="Measure"),
            alt.Tooltip("score:Q", title="Score (%)", format=".1f"),
            alt.Tooltip("modality:N", title="Modality"),
            alt.Tooltip("reasoning_type:N", title="Reasoning type"),
        ],
    )
    .add_params(modality_filter, reasoning_filter)
    .transform_filter(
        "(modality_filter == 'All') || (datum.modality == modality_filter)"
    )
    .transform_filter(
        "(reasoning_filter == 'All') || "
        "(datum.reasoning_type == reasoning_filter)"
    )
    .properties(width=650, height=alt.Step(24))
    .interactive()
)

chart
```
